text:
marie: Quick sync — follow-ups from the partial-response / timeout postmortem. Proposing a rotating ownership model (3-week cycles) + a standing 15m weekly checkpoint. Immediate asks: assign owners for reconnect logic, client/backpressure telemetry, and small-batch failure handling.

jamal: +1. I can take reconnect logic for weeks 1-3. Plan: add jittered exponential backoff in client lib, server-side handshake timeout tuning, and a small canary test. ETA EOD Thu.

sophia: I'll own client/backpressure telemetry. Task: add per-conn pending-token metric, surface alerts for >3s tail token latency, and a dashboard. Will open a PR with dashboard link.

alex_r: I can pick up small-batch failure handling. First step: reproduce partial responses locally (see repro steps below) and validate retry semantics. ETA next Tue.

marie: I'm tagging owners into the incident board and updating the runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4578 — please add short notes to the ticket as you make progress.

jamal: Repro steps for reconnect race (local):
```bash
# simulate flaky network
python tools/sim_net.py --drop 1/20 --latency 200
# run stream client against staging mirror
python examples/chat_stream.py --model gptx --messages 100
```
This reproduces truncated partial responses ~40% of the time for me.

sophia: Dashboard template saved at /dashboards/streaming_reliability.json. I'll attach the perf panels in the PR.

benji: Ops note — when we change handshake timeout, schedule a non-overlap oncall window for canary deploys. I'll own the calendar invite and ops checklist.

marie: Cadence: weekly 15m on Tue 10:30am PST for rapid syncs; full rotation review every 3 weeks. Owners should post a 1-paragraph status in #incidents before the weekly check-in.

tariq: Observed recurring pattern: spikes align with 99th percentile token bursts from a small set of dedicated customers. Suggest adding a priority routing rule to divert heavy bursts to a low-memory variant when queue depth > 50, as an immediate mitigation.

jamal: Agreed. Add to backlog INF-4603 and we'll test in staging using traffic mirror.

incidents-bot: Created task INF-4602 'Reconnect jitter + server handshake tuning' assigned to jamal, due 2026-04-02

marie: Action list (copied here for visibility):
- jamal: reconnect jitter + handshake tuning — due 2026-04-02
- sophia: per-conn telemetry + alerts — due 2026-03-30
- alex_r: small-batch repro & retry strategy — due 2026-04-06
- benji: canary calendar & ops runbook update — due 2026-03-28

tariq: I'll run a 48h traffic mirror next week and post metrics on INF-4603.

marie: Thanks all. If you need to swap ownership ping me or mention @marie. :thumbsup:

alex_r: Quick note — I'll include a small test harness that simulates the reconnect handshake in CI to catch regressions.

sophia: Will add alert thresholds to avoid noisy alerts (propose 5min grouping, 1 incident per 15m).

benji: Scheduling invite sent. Ops checklist attached to INF-4602.

marie: Closing loop: owners will post short status updates in the ticket every 3 days until closure. We'll re-evaluate rotation policy after first 3-week cycle.

jamal: Logged initial PR + perf run to INF-4602.

incidents-bot: Marked INF-4602 as in-progress.

marie: End of thread — next check-in Tue 10:30am PST.
